title: Build: one fold for sums and products

checklist.step: Fold every term in, once each, in order
Show the running result after every point

hints: A sum and a product differ in two places only: the value they start from and how one term is folded in.
Look at what result must be before any point is visited, and what visiting one point does to it.
Loop while the point is at most b: compute the term once, combine it with result on the left, record the point and the term, show, then step with next.
